title.narrative: Social Cash Transfer Programme (SCTP) increased by 26 per cent, reaching 381,735 households (738,657 children), and expanded to 293,631 shock-affected households. UNICEF influenced a 59 per cent increase in SCTP’s cash transfer value, adoption of an inclusive targeting approach, and expansion of gender-transformative activities to 10 districts, reaching 25,840 people.
